images.prompt: Camera and composition: top-down flat lay view of a table with three to five related objects neatly arranged, no people. Color theme: sage green and sand beige tones with a coral accent. Natural realistic photograph look, soft daylight, shallow depth of field, real Korean people and real Korean places, warm everyday mood, natural colors, clean composition. Show only what is described above as the main subject; do not add other large objects that are not described. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, labels, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No money, banknotes, coins or currency symbols anywhere. Do not depict any real or famous person; every face is an ordinary fictional person.
